description: React component implementing a modal dialog for adding a new habit, managing local form state, user interactions, and communicating with a data layer to create the habit.

methods.name: AddHabitModal
methods.description: React functional component providing a modal interface to add new habits.

parameters.open: Boolean flag indicating if the modal is visible
parameters.onClose: Callback function to close the modal
parameters.onCreated: Callback function invoked after a habit is successfully created

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the form fields and error state to initial values.

methods.name: handleSubmit
methods.description: Handles form submission, validates input, calls createHabit API, manages loading/error states, and triggers callbacks.
